invariants.title: Type coherence
invariants.test: every symbol in the operator expression has a declared domain and codomain and the composition type-checks

invariants.title: Totality
invariants.test: the iterated map is total on its declared domain

invariants.title: Existence
invariants.test: a fixed point is proved to exist under stated hypotheses, or its absence is a declared outcome

invariants.title: Certificate soundness
invariants.test: the stopping rule implies a bound on distance to a fixed point, with all constants reported

invariants.title: Reproducibility
invariants.test: bit-identical re-execution follows from a stated contract, not from a number representation

invariants.title: Non-circularity
invariants.test: no component of the validation set is produced by the object under validation

invariants.title: Attainability
invariants.test: every obligation is satisfiable by some admissible artefact and falsifiable by observation

invariants.title: Comparability
invariants.test: any comparative claim specifies budget, seeds, statistical test and effect size
